propositions: Provider qualifiers are currently decided by regex shape matching rather than membership in a known registry, allowing typos and future model ids with non-qualified prefixes to be silently accepted
The shape regex _PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE rejects valid slash-containing provider names (gateway/anthropic, gateway/openai, etc.) while accepting non-existent ones like google_genai or test
Configured provider typos like 'bedrok' are not validated at config-resolution time but only fail later at provider construction

split_provider_qualifier must decide by membership in a static frozenset KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES while treating unknown inline prefixes as unqualified, and _resolve_target must validate explicitly configured providers against the same set
The static set must contain exactly the 24 names from pydantic-ai's known providers with test and google_genai excluded, and a drift test must ensure runtime registries remain a subset
